criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Improve gui/evidence-viewer so reviewing video and recovered evidence comes first, while removing unnecessary UI noise.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: The first screen surfaces source evidence, video candidates, validation state, export preview, and report package flow with local-first, candidate-unvalidated, and verification-required forensic wording.
criteriaCoverage.userOutcomeReview: Captured agbrowse evidence and independent review show the viewer-first workflow, candidate/recovered items, status controls, report/export reachability, no horizontal overflow, empty console captures, clean cleanup, and unchanged Rust regression behavior.
